types.name: ShaderBackgroundProps
types.doc: An animated backdrop: a slow, flowing noise field drawn on a WebGL canvas and tinted with the accent color. It reads its colors from the design tokens (and follows theme and accent changes), stops drawing while it is off screen or the tab is hidden, holds one still frame under reduced motion, and leaves a flat surface when WebGL is not available.

members.name: speed
members.doc: Flow speed multiplier. 1 is a calm drift; 0 freezes the field.

members.name: scale
members.doc: Zoom of the noise field. Larger values show finer, busier detail.

members.name: intensity
members.doc: How strongly the accent tints the field, from 0 (barely there) to 1.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Holds the current frame. The field resumes from the same place.

members.name: quality
members.doc: Render resolution as a fraction of the display pixels, from 0.25 to 1. The field is soft, so a lower value costs less and rarely shows.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
